summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K consolidating weekly UK buyback disclosures, a block admission and a total voting rights notice; the UK equivalent of US issuer repurchase reporting. Purchases ran 28 Sep–9 Oct 2026 via J.P. Morgan Securities plc on the LSE, totaling roughly 746,868 and 738,220 ordinary shares in successive weeks at volume-weighted prices of about 2,504p–2,701p, held in treasury. Since 2 Jan 2026 the issuer has repurchased 81,968,579 shares; 86.1M sit in treasury against 1,743.0M shares outstanding. A 65,000-share block admission under the 2023 Executive Share Ownership Scheme settles 19 Oct. Watch buyback pace relative to the authorization and any acceleration or slowdown signal.
